title: ⚠️ Do NOT download this app — it’s a trap - overly priced for a to do list
body:
Wisely pretends is just a to-do list app, it’s nothing more than a very basic checklist hidden behind a terrible UI and clunky UX. It feels outdated and frustrating to use.

The worst part is their shady billing. You will start a trial in the browser, and without any clear confirmation they start charging. Even after cancelling, they kept charging me. This feels dishonest and exploitative.

Save yourself the headache — there are countless better, fairer, and more trustworthy apps out there. Wisely is not worth your time or money.
author: Saba2025k
